# BlobUpload

`schemas/api/blob-upload.json`

One unclaimed upload (docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md P2): the answer to POST /v1/blobs, an item of GET /v1/blobs (operator only), and the payload of blob.upload_purged. Only a later command by the same actor may reference it, before expires_at; its bytes are never served back.

No other fields are allowed.
